query:
-- Add year tags and missing tags to all projects
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'American Idiot' AND t.name IN ('2018', 'Contemporary')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Urinetown' AND t.name IN ('2024', 'Satire', 'Dystopian', 'Political Satire', 'University Theatre')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Head Over Heels' AND t.name IN ('2023', 'Jukebox Musical', 'LGBTQ+ Themes', 'Fairy Tale')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = '¡LOTERIA: GAME ON!' AND t.name IN ('2023', 'Latinx Theatre')

INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'The Pajama Game' AND t.name IN ('2019', 'Labor Movement')

INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t

INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'All My Sons' AND t.name IN ('2010')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
